subject: Private Offer acceptance playbook & invoice tranche plan
messages:
From: Eliza Harper <eliza@clearhealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Acceptance checklist for Redwood private offer (PO + invoices)

Hi Tessa / Laura,

Thanks for the walkthrough on Friday — attached is the PO draft from our procurement team. Before we execute, a couple of clarifications from our side so we can get internal approvals:

- We need the private offer acceptance steps documented so our cloud team can confirm the AWS console acceptance checklist (who does the acceptance, expected timestamps).
- We prefer invoicing in 3 tranches: 40% on signature, 40% at 6 months, 20% at 12 months. Can Redwood accommodate split invoices against a single PO?
- Please confirm Redwood's tax handling: we are US-headquartered (no VAT), but need a W-9 or tax-form reference for our AP team.

Attached: ClearHealth_PO.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

Thanks,
Eliza Harper
Procurement Lead
ClearHealth Systems
(eliza@clearhealth.com)
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: Eliza Harper <eliza@clearhealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-23T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acceptance checklist for Redwood private offer (PO + invoices)

Hi Eliza — thanks, received the PO. Quick answers and an acceptance playbook below. I've attached a concise playbook PDF for your cloud and procurement teams.

High-level acceptance playbook (our recommended sequence):
1) Procurement signs PO and returns signed PDF (you mentioned that is in progress).
2) Redwood generates private offer in AWS Marketplace and posts acceptance link. We share the link with your cloud admin (typically 24–48 hours after PO).
3) Your cloud admin clicks Accept in the AWS Marketplace console; AWS processes and assigns the subscription to your AWS account (we'll include console screenshots in the playbook).
4) Once accepted, Redwood issues the first invoice against the PO for tranche 1 (40%). Subsequent tranches are scheduled per the dates you confirm.
5) We confirm activation on our side and open a short 7-day verification window for performance checks.

Answers to your questions:
- Split invoices: yes, we can issue multiple invoices against a single PO. We will reference the PO number and include tranche number on each invoice.
- Tax docs: attaching W-9 and a short note about tax handling in US deals.
- Responsible parties: Redwood will own steps 2 and 4; ClearHealth cloud admin owns the console acceptance in step 3.

Attachments: redwood-acceptance-playbook.pdf; W9_redwood.pdf (stub)

Next step: if this looks good, please return Signed_PO_ClearHealth.pdf and confirm the desired tranche dates (we'll propose default cadence of signature date, +6 months, +12 months).

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
From: tessa_morgan@redwood.com
To: marcus_lin@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: 2027-08-24T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Accepted PO incoming? Need invoice cadence & tax confirmation

Folks — looping you both on ClearHealth (Deal D-CH-9843). Procurement sent the PO and prefers 3-tranche invoicing. Key asks for finance:
- Can Redwood issue tranche invoices referencing one PO number? (Yes, but finance needs the PO format and final PO number.)
- We need a sample invoice (they asked for invoice-sample.xlsx) that shows PO number, tranche label, and due dates.
- Confirm tax handling & include W-9 reference on invoices.

Marcus: please confirm whether we can set payment terms for tranche 1 at NET30 and subsequent tranches NET30 from invoice date (ClearHealth typically needs NET30). If we can, I'll request the signed PO and give them a proposed invoice schedule.

Marissa: once Marcus confirms, can you prepare a sample invoice and a billing note that AP can attach when sending the tranche invoices?

Thanks — will update after I get the signed PO back.

— Tessa
